mechanism_narrative: A lower current federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS is below 1.0% (as of t-1mo), the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% indicates a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE above 5.0% (as of t-1mo) is associated with positive 5-day S&P 500 returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high inflation (CPIAUCSL above 235.0) and a stagnant federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS not declining from the previous month) signals a failure of monetary policy to control inflation, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL > 235.0 AND FEDFUNDS change (t-1mo vs t-2mo) <= 0
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 235.0 and FEDFUNDS change <= 0, the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals weakening consumer demand and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where UNRATE < 4.0%, a decline in HOUST (relative to the previous month) is associated with positive 20-day S&P 500 returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market, indicated by high employment growth (PAYEMS), supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS growth (t-1mo vs t-2mo) exceeds 100,000, the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO below 100) indicates a weakening manufacturing sector that reduces corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO below 100 (as of t-1mo) is associated with positive 60-day S&P 500 returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of weak housing starts (HOUST below 900) and declining industrial production (INDPRO below 100) signals a broad-based economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST < 900 and INDPRO < 100, the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL above 235.0), the Federal Reserve is expected to tighten monetary policy, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where CPIAUCSL > 235.0, the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases.
